name: RNA-seq differential expression
description: Compare gene counts between two groups of samples: drop genes with too few reads, normalise to log counts per million, test every gene and draw a volcano plot.

slots.question: Which columns are the control samples?
Which columns are the treated samples?

steps.name: Filter low counts
steps.purpose: Keep genes with enough reads to test.

min_count.label: Minimum reads
min_count.meaning: Reads a gene needs in a sample to count as expressed there.

min_samples.label: In at least
min_samples.meaning: Samples in which a gene must reach the minimum.
min_samples.consequence: Higher keeps only broadly expressed genes.

steps.name: Normalise to log CPM
steps.purpose: Make samples with different sequencing depth comparable.

steps.name: Test genes
steps.purpose: Find genes whose expression differs between the groups.

fdr.label: False discovery rate
fdr.meaning: Share of called genes that may be false positives.

min_lfc.label: Minimum fold change
min_lfc.meaning: How far apart the group means must be.

steps.name: Volcano plot
steps.purpose: Show fold change against significance for every gene.
